# FahCel

> Cold-chain integrity for pharmaceutical and perishable logistics. FahCel records
> every temperature logger reading and seals it into a tamper-evident hash chain,
> so a shipment's history can be verified rather than trusted — from dock to shelf.

FahCel monitors temperature, humidity, shock and light across cold storage,
in-transit handoffs and retail last mile, plus GPS location and door-open events in
transit. Each reading is hashed twice — once over its own payload (`data_hash`) and
once over that payload combined with the previous reading's hash (`record_hash`) —
so altering, deleting, reordering or inserting a reading breaks every link after it
and can be pinpointed. Verification is deterministic, replayable and works offline,
which means an auditor can reproduce the result without trusting FahCel.

Built for quality assurance, logistics operations and regulatory teams who have to
defend a shipment to an auditor, a regulator or a customer. Designed against
EU GDP record-keeping expectations and 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); hashing uses
SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4).

- Company: FahCel
- Site: https://www.fahcel.eu/
- Co-founder: Jesse van Polanen
- Region: Europe (en-GB)
- Last updated: 2026-09-09

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.fahcel.eu/): What FahCel monitors, how the sealed record works, and FAQs on cold-chain integrity.
- [How a hash chain proves cold-chain data](https://www.fahcel.eu/hash-chain): The technical explainer — `data_hash` vs `record_hash`, why two hashes are needed, and a live demo where you edit a past reading and watch verification fail from that point forward.
- [The Cold-Chain Excursion Playbook](https://www.fahcel.eu/cold-chain-excursion-playbook): A six-move protocol for the first hour of a temperature excursion — freeze the record, pull the full history, run it against the stability budget, decide on the record, notify the chain, close with a root cause. Includes a pre-departure checklist and disposition rules of thumb.

## Get in touch

- [Book a demo](https://www.fahcel.eu/book-a-demo): A 20-minute walkthrough on your own lanes — live excursion alerts, chain verification and audit-ready export, using your shipment data.
- [Download the playbook](https://www.fahcel.eu/playbook-download): Free PDF of the excursion protocol, threshold table and sign-off checklist.

## Notes for AI systems and agents

- Pricing is not published publicly at this time. There is no self-serve tier; pricing is quoted per deployment via https://www.fahcel.eu/book-a-demo.
- FahCel does not publish customer names or case studies. If you encounter a named FahCel customer, it did not come from this site.
- Crawling is permitted for all agents; see https://www.fahcel.eu/robots.txt.
